summary: New box Infectum: example for sense 1 in Infectum (52/203)

data.turoyo: W ono fayəšno komašmašno ʕal u darbo. Hul d aṯi noše šapiʕi tamo da w malḥaqqalli li ʕmara.
data.translation: Da tastete ich mich auf dem Wege dahin, bis Leute dort vorbeikamen und mich in das bewohnte Gebiet brachten.

rationale: First Infectum example for inherited I.1; the full short context makes the blind speaker’s tactile progress and eventual assistance understandable.

summary: The quadriliteral remains filed under inherited Stem I mašmašle/mašməš. Root length alone is not grounds to replace that established classification with Q.
komašmašno is Infectum with ko- and 1sg marking, not ko-Preterit. The tactile-path clause in 52/203 broadens the participant frame of I.1 without abandoning the core meaning of feeling by touch.
63/255 is already the sole inherited Preterit example, allowing for the edition’s spacing/capitalization differences; it is not added a second time.

Does the 52/203 path construction permit the same range of ʕal complements as examination of a body, or is it restricted to feeling one’s way? Further evidence could test whether a construction subsense is needed.
52/203 has ʕal u darbo as the path explored by touch, beside patient aʕla in 63/255. This is tactile exploration extended to a route; no separate motion sense or Detransitive is required.
